items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Airlines and he had a friend with him called Tito

ctx.x: Airlines and he had a friend with him called Tito and they claimed that they came-- that they had been listening to my records in Buenos Aires for a year and they wanted to come and hear me personally - they heard I was there; one guy was 2,000 miles from there; he flew in just to get there for that night and the other guy was already in Copenhagen and, uh, they were so enthusiastic that when I got through playing that night, I said - why don't you come up to my house and I'll play some tapes and things.
